title: SIX FOOT FOUR, UPSIDE DOWN
passages: At forty-eight, six foot four, and around 240 pounds, I decided to learn a handstand. Then I let people watch the awkward part.

There were headstand failures, kick-ups, sore muscles, drills, and days when the progress felt boring. Ten attempts could mean ten small failures and ten reasons to return. The challenge gave the bigger story something concrete: a body learning to trust a new position, and a man learning to keep a promise to himself.
